message.reasoning_content: We need to list crimes directly supported by the facts. Facts: Peng Moumou participated in theft (as lookout) and shared proceeds. Also later assisted police capturing drug dealer, leading to seizure of heroin, methamphetamine, etc. That could be considered "立功" but not a crime. The theft: He was a lookout and helped conceal, so he is liable for theft (共同犯罪). Also possibly "帮助盗窃罪"? In Chinese criminal law, participants in theft are charged with theft. So "盗窃罪". Also "销赃" maybe "非法买卖赃物"? But he only split proceeds, not sell. Could be "非法占有他人财物罪"? That's theft. Also "帮助他人隐匿、转移、变卖、收购、运输、携带、存放赃物罪"? He split proceeds, not necessarily handling. Might be "帮助盗窃罪"? However Chinese law doesn't have separate "帮助盗窃" but participants are charged with theft. So just "盗窃罪". Also maybe "妨害公务罪"? No. The later part: He helped police capture drug dealer, which is a "立功" not a crime. So no drug-related crime for him. So answer: 盗窃罪. Use format: [罪名]盗窃罪<eoa>
